This report summarizes the institute’s activities during fiscal year 2025, as required by statute. It describes progress in four areas: advanced manufacturing, cybersecurity and privacy, quantum science, and standards for emerging technologies. Highlights include the release of updated guidance for federal agencies on managing cybersecurity risk, the demonstration of a chip-scale atomic clock with improved stability, and the launch of a public-private partnership to develop measurement tools for artificial intelligence systems. The report also provides financial data, including appropriations and expenditures by program area, and describes the institute’s workforce and facilities. The institute continues to face challenges in maintaining aging laboratory infrastructure, and the report identifies priority investments needed over the next five years. Additional detail on each topic is available in the appendices.
